# Apokrif Universe

> Apokrif is a hand-drawn dark fantasy graphic novel braiding history, myth, and science fiction. Co-created by Emmy Award-winning writer Conor Sheehy and concept artist Aron Elekes. A free prologue (Et Tamen, Episode 0) is available; the full graphic novel is launching on Kickstarter.

## About the story

The world of Apokrif is set after the 2125 Betrayal, when the colony ship Hope was hijacked by vampires. Humanity shattered into warring factions. Ex Sanguis, a militant religious cult, hunts vampires and often innocents. House Matani and Cradle are the other central factions. The graphic novel is set in 2177.

## Creators

- [Conor Sheehy](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#team): Co-Creator and Writer. Emmy Award-winning writer.
- [Aron Elekes](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#team): Concept Artist and Illustrator.

- [Home](https://etamen.up.railway.app/): Full overview of the Apokrif Universe.
- [Et Tamen prologue](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#et): Free 14-page prologue episode.
- [The Graphic Novel](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#novel): How each page is hand-crafted from concept to illustration.
- [Factions](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#factions): Ex Sanguis, House Matani, Cradle.
- [Timeline](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#timeline): Nine canonical events from 2059 to 2177.
- [Team](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#team): Conor Sheehy and Aron Elekes.
- [Community](https://etamen.up.railway.app/#community): Kickstarter backer involvement and Instagram.

## Kickstarter

Apokrif is in Kickstarter pre-launch. Higher-tier backers vote on environment and character concept art. Top-tier backers can have their likeness placed as characters within the novel.
